topic: 世界模型需要什么样的训练数据？
notes: agent dynamic expansion (medium): The topic asks what training data robot world models need, so add data-composition and data-quality queries beyond the static world-model taxonomy.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-world-model-training-data
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"world model" AND all:"training data" AND all:robot
dynamic_suggestions.why: Directly target papers that discuss training data for robot world models.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-world-model-robot-interaction-data
dynamic_suggestions.why: Find world models trained on embodied interaction rather than generic video only.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-world-model-action-conditioned-video-data
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"action-conditioned" AND all:video AND all:"robot manipulation"
dynamic_suggestions.why: Find papers where actions are explicit conditioning signals for video/world-model training.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-world-model-failure-trajectories
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"failure trajectories" AND all:robot AND (all:"world model" OR all:"video-action")
dynamic_suggestions.why: Search for failure or recovery trajectories used to train useful predictive models.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-world-model-corrective-trajectories
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"corrective trajectories" AND all:robot AND all:"world model"
dynamic_suggestions.why: Capture human-in-the-world-model or post-training data generated from corrective interventions.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-world-model-physics-aware-annotation
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"physics-aware" AND all:annotation AND all:"world model"
dynamic_suggestions.why: Find papers adding physical annotations or preference signals to world-model data.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-world-model-synthetic-demonstrations
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"synthetic demonstrations" AND all:robot AND all:"world model"
dynamic_suggestions.why: Search for synthetic or generated demonstrations used for robot policy/world-model training.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-world-model-event-preserving-data
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"event-preserving" AND all:robot AND all:"world model"
dynamic_suggestions.why: Find work arguing that sparse manipulation events like contact or grasp must be preserved in data.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-world-model-training-data-browser
dynamic_suggestions.query: site:arxiv.org/abs ("world model" OR "video-action world model") robot "training data"
dynamic_suggestions.why: Browser fallback for robot world-model training-data papers.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-world-model-training-data-web
dynamic_suggestions.why: Calibrate wording for current robot world-model training-data discussions.

calibration_notes: arxiv-search calibration (high): Interactive World Simulator uses terms such as moderate-sized robot interaction dataset, world-model-generated data, and sim-real correlation.
arxiv-search calibration (high): ABot-PhysWorld uses terms such as physics-aware annotation and manipulation clips.
arxiv-search calibration (high): Hi-WM uses terms such as corrective trajectories, rollback, branching, and failure-targeted policy improvement.
arxiv-search calibration (high): tau0-WM uses terms such as real-robot teleoperation, UMI-style interaction, egocentric human videos, and rollout or failure trajectories.
arxiv-search calibration (high): SKIP uses terms such as event-preserving keyframes and task-relevant events.
